shortDescription: MPESB MSPSTET 2026 eligibility examination rulebook for serving primary and secondary teachers. Applications are scheduled from 21 August to 4 September 2026 and the exam starts 12 October 2026.
content:
The Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) has issued the MSPSTET 2026 Rule Book for serving teachers teaching in primary and secondary classes. This is an eligibility examination and does not announce recruitment vacancies.

Online applications are scheduled from 21 August 2026 to 4 September 2026. Application correction is available from 21 August 2026 to 9 September 2026. The examination starts on 12 October 2026 in two shifts.

The examination fee is ₹1,000 per question paper, plus an MP Online portal charge of ₹60 through a kiosk or ₹20 through a registered citizen user. Read the official rulebook for department-wise eligibility, syllabus, exam scheme, identity requirements and other conditions.

How to apply

  1. Download and read the official rulebook from the link below.
  2. Confirm your serving-teacher and department-wise eligibility.
  3. Submit the online application through the official MPESB portal and pay the applicable fee.
  4. Use the correction window, if required, and save the confirmation page.
editorNotes: Independent listing for candidates. NaukriMitra is not a government website. Always open the official recruiting-body URL before paying a fee or relying on a result.
importantInstructions: Do not share login OTPs. Download PDFs only from the official domain. Dates and vacancy counts on aggregator sites can lag behind the notice.

faqs.question: Where can I download the MSPSTET 2026 Rule Book?
faqs.answer: Download the official rule book from the notification link on this page and confirm any later correction on https://esb.mp.gov.in.

faqs.question: What does the MSPSTET 2026 Rule Book contain?
faqs.answer: It contains the teacher eligibility requirements, syllabus, examination pattern, application instructions and other conditions for the notified process.

faqs.question: What should I keep ready?
faqs.answer: Photo, signature, educational certificates, category certificate (if any) and valid photo ID
